mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS (email, fail_count, locked_until, last_failed_at) VALUES (#{email}, 1, NULL, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fail_count = IF(locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= #{now}, 1, fail_count + 1), locked_until = IF(fail_count >= #{maxAttempts}, TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, #{lockMinutes}, #{now}), NULL), last_failed_at = #{now}
